worldcombat.skill.scald.summary: Boils a kettle of water in its palm and hurls it: the scalding water arcs onto the target, dealing special damage and possibly burning, then leaves a still-rolling puddle where it lands. Anyone stepping in is scalded, and standing in it scalds them again and again. Boiling water thaws frozen targets and the user, and hits an already-wet target harder.
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.0: Burn a target from range with a thrown kettle of boiling water
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.1: Leave a scalding puddle that locks down a patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.2: Thaw frozen on the target and on yourself
worldcombat.skill.scald.use.3: Scald an already-wet target for extra damage
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.0: A hit deals %1$s special damage; the target's special defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.1: Range: %1$s blocks. Projectile speed: %2$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.2: A hit has a %1$s chance to burn the target, and spreads a %2$s block puddle at the landing point.
worldcombat.skill.scald.description.3: The puddle rolls for %1$s s; stepping in has a %4$s burn chance, and standing inside takes %2$s damage every %3$s s until it dries up.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.thaw: The boiling water thaws a frozen target; boiling the kettle also thaws the user.
worldcombat.skill.scald.rule.wet: An already-wet target is scalded worse: hit damage x1.18.
worldcombat.skill.scald.simmer.on: Long-boil: a bigger, longer-lived puddle that scalds more readily, at the cost of x0.9 direct power and +10 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.scald.simmer.off: Flash-boil: x1.06 direct power and -2 cooldown, with a small, short puddle.
worldcombat.skill.scald.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.scald.growth.0: From level %1$s the boil rises to %2$s power and %3$s burn chance.
worldcombat.skill.scald.growth.1: From level %1$s the boil rises to %2$s power, the puddle to %3$s blocks and the slick burn chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.simme: On: a bigger, longer-lived puddle that scalds more readily, but x0.9 direct power and +10 cooldown, for locking down ground. Off (flash-boil): x1.06 direct power and -2 cooldown, with a small, short puddle, for picking a target off.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.scald.preference.ai.so: On: already-wet targets rank first for the extra 18%% scald damage; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
On: a target with other enemies nearby ranks first so the puddle locks them down too; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
